candidate.title: miTRAP
candidate.scope: The single miTRAP (miRNA trapping by RNA in vitro affinity purification) row in the supplied Illumina poster crop, ending at cDNA, clarified with Braun et al. (2014). The initial miRNA-labelled 'RNA-protein complex' and its arrows are preserved as diagram observations in c_loading; loading components and order in the graph are explicitly resolved from the primary paper. Amylose binding, cell-extract incubation, complex recovery, miRNA isolation and the cDNA interface are the scoped route. The neighboring DLAF and CLASH rows, partial TRAP-Seq row and right-hand chemical legend supply no miTRAP operations or end-group assignments. No alternative miTRAP branch, split or pooling is depicted.

operations.label: Bind in vitro transcribed bait RNA
operations.description: Load the amylose affinity support with the recombinant MBP–MS2 coat-protein bridge, then immobilize the in vitro transcribed MS2-tagged bait. Soluble bait and capture components become a resin-bound bait assembly. This primary-resolved loading order is documented in correction c_loading.
operations.mechanism: MS2 stem-loops on the bait bind MS2 coat protein fused to MBP; MBP anchors the assembly to amylose. This expands the otherwise unlabeled affinity linkage, without assigning a chemical identity to each cartoon subshape.
operations.information_effect: The chosen bait sequence defines which cellular miRNA associations the subsequent capture can interrogate.
